# Joseph and Aseneth Chapter 12 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Greek MS | **Section:** The Honeycomb Burns; Aseneth Sees a Vision of the Eighth Heaven

---

**1** The man stretched out his right hand and traced a line across the honeycomb with his finger, from east to west. The path of his finger turned to fire and the comb burned up — but no smoke rose from it.

**2** Aseneth stared in amazement, trembling with fear.

**3** 'Did you see that?' the man asked. 'Yes, lord,' Aseneth said. 'I saw everything.'

**4** 'That is how the words of my mouth are,' the man said. 'They are sweet as honey — and they burn like fire, consuming the enemies of the righteous.'

**5** Aseneth said to the man: 'Lord, I have seven virgin companions who grew up with me. May I bring them to you? I would like you to bless them as you have blessed me.'

**6** 'Bring them,' the man said. Aseneth brought the seven virgins, and the man blessed them: 'May the Lord God Most High bless you. You will be like the seven pillars of the City of Refuge, and all its chosen inhabitants will rest upon you forever.'

**7** 'Take the table away,' the man said. When Aseneth turned to move it, the man of God was instantly taken up to heaven in a chariot of fire.

**8** Aseneth said: 'How foolish I was — how bold! I spoke so freely to the man of God without knowing he was a son of God. Yet he told me my name is written in the Book of the Living in heaven.'

---
*PNEUMA: modern English; verse-only numbering.*
